Description.DefaultText: A spirit blessing. Calms you down, slows down your thirst and helps you heal from rashes and damage on the feet and hands.
Description.Text: 一个精魄赐福。让你平静下来，减缓你的口渴，帮助你治愈足部和手部的皮疹和损伤。
Description.zh: 一个精魄赐福。让你平静下来，减缓你的口渴，帮助你治愈足部和手部的皮疹和损伤。
Description.en: A spirit blessing. Calms you down, slows down your thirst and helps you heal from rashes and damage on the feet and hands.
Description.ja: 精霊の祝福。精神を落ち着かせ、喉の渇きを抑え、手足の回復がはやくなる。
